researchment.title: Researchment
researchment.content: Currently working as postdoctoral researcher at University of Rouen, vcastor's research goes from QTAIM and IQA analysis to NMR and Conceptual DFT calculations. VCastor has worked in the groups of Tomás Rocha Rinza, Julia Contreras-García, Laurent Joubert and Vincent Tognetti, focusing on hydrogen bonds, topological analysis of the electron density and electron localisation function, also on the development of polarisability and dipole moment under the QTAIM partition. She has written the modules for QTAIM dipole moment and polarisability for SCM (ADF, BAND and DFTB), as well as refactoring other parts of the QTAIM analysis. Her PhD thesis was focused on the chemical reactivity from the prespective of the topological analysis of the density and Conceptual DFT, taking into account the solvent effects. You can read her PhD manuscript.
